summary.value: We introduce gte-v1.5 series, upgraded gte embeddings that support the context length of up to 8192, while further enhancing model performance. The models are built upon the transformer++ encoder backbone (BERT + RoPE + GLU).

value.title: mGTE: Generalized Long-Context Text Representation and Reranking Models for Multilingual Text Retrieval
Towards General Text Embeddings with Multi-stage Contrastive Learning
